correctness.rationale: For each pair the squared projection operator is (a_i^T a_j)^2 P_i. Conditional minimization in Loewner order and reflection yield the exact lower bound max{q(1-u)(1-t),ut+qu(1-t)}. The two affine branches meet at the stated t for u<1/2; above they are minimized at zero center mass. Explicit symmetric laws attain equality, and offdiagonal/strict-Loewner arguments classify all equality cases. The exact rational cases and finite LP cross-checks in the packaged checker passed; finite checks are not the universal proof.

value.rationale: This smallest symmetric overdetermined planar row family supports two distinct sharp sampling-policy transitions: a change in the second-row choice at u=1/4 and complete omission of the center as first row at u=1/2. The exact classification concerns all ordered-pair laws and all initial directions, not a toy fixed schedule. The strict rho=3/80 versus best deterministic 1/16 at u=3/8 exhibits why marginally less-correlated pair selection alone is not globally minimax; at u=3/4 rho=3/16 versus uniform IID 11/18. The result is a bounded, motivated finite-horizon benchmark without claiming a solver speedup.
